planets.name: K2-133 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-133 with a 11-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: K2-133 d was found in 2017 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around K2-133. Its orbit and size follow Wells et al. 2019's fit, the archive's default.
